**Description**


HR Specialist
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**


Responsibilities:

* Manage end\-to\-end HR processes related to onboarding, offboarding, promotions, transfers, employee lifecycle events, and benefits setup.
* Prepare, validate, and facilitate the issuance of HR letters and employment\-related documentation, including offer letters, promotion letters, transfer letters, experience letters, and other employee correspondence, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
* Coordinate and provide timely inputs to payroll, benefits, compensation, and other stakeholder teams to support employee transactions and lifecycle changes.
* Maintain employee records and ensure data accuracy, integrity, and compliance within HRIS systems.
* Respond to employee and manager inquiries regarding HR policies, pay, benefits, leave management, performance processes, and company guidelines through Workday Help; independently resolve queries or appropriately escalate complex issues.
* Support internal audits and ensure compliance with employment legislation, company policies, and data privacy requirements.
* Create, maintain, and update process documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to enhance operational efficiency within a tiered service delivery model.
* Collaborate closely with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), Payroll, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, and other HR functions to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Handle sensitive and confidential employee information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.
* Participate in projects, process improvement initiatives, and system enhancements, providing operational insights and recommendations.
* Effectively manage workload, prioritize activities based on business needs and service level commitments, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.


Requirements:

* Minimum 3 \- 5 years of experience
* Experience in exposure of HR operations \& knowledge of HR operations processes.
* Analytical \& customer service oriented
* Workday knowledge \- mandatory
* Ticketing tool experience \- mandatory
* Proficient in Microsoft Office
* English level \- advanced

**Get to know Syneos Health**


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

  

http://www.syneoshealth.com

**Additional Information**


Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

**Summary**


The HR Specialist provides administrative and operational support across core HR processes, ensuring accurate execution of employee lifecycle activities. This role operates within established procedures and guidelines, with growing autonomy and responsibility. The HR Specialist interacts regularly with employees and managers, delivering high\-quality service while maintaining confidentiality and compliance.

**About CCS**
-------------


Centre for Civil Society (CCS) is India's leading public policy think tank advancing social change through public policy. Founded in 1997, CCS works to expand opportunity and choice through evidence\-based research, pilot interventions, policy engagement, and capacity\-building initiatives.


CCS works across education, livelihoods, governance, and institutional reform. Through rigorous research and practical implementation, CCS seeks to generate evidence that informs policy, improves programme effectiveness, and strengthens public institutions.


We are looking for a people\-oriented and organised HR professional and help build a workplace where people can learn, grow and do their best work.


This is a hands\-on role that brings together HR, Learning \& Development and Administration. The right person should enjoy working with people, be comfortable managing processes, and have the ability to take things from planning to execution.


**What will you do?**
---------------------


### **Learning \& Development**


* Work with the L\&D Lead to plan and run CCS's annual learning and development initiatives.
* Coordinate training programmes, workshops, mentoring and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Work with managers and employees to understand learning and development needs.
* Track participation, feedback and learning outcomes, and improve programmes based on what we learn.
* Support employees in making the most of internal and external learning opportunities.

### **HR \& Employee Experience**


* Support key HR processes across the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, engagement, performance management and exits.
* Help create a positive employee experience and keep communication with employees clear and timely.
* Support performance and feedback processes and help managers with the tools and processes they need.
* Organise employee engagement and culture\-building initiatives.
* Maintain employee records and ensure HR processes and policies are followed.

### **Administration**


* Manage day\-to\-day administrative requirements and respond to employee requests.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers and ensure office requirements are taken care of.
* Help improve administrative processes, reduce unnecessary manual work and introduce simple systems where useful.
* Support office planning, procurement and other operational requirements.

### **Systems \& Reporting**


* Maintain HR, L\&D and administrative trackers and dashboards.
* Help employees adopt and use CCS's internal systems and tools effectively.
* Prepare periodic reports and updates for the L\&D Lead and leadership team.
* Look for ways to make our people and administrative processes simpler and more efficient.

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We are looking for someone who is:


* People\-oriented and approachable, with good interpersonal skills.
* Organised and dependable, with strong follow\-through.
* Comfortable managing multiple things at the same time without losing attention to detail.
* A good communicator who can work with employees, managers, leadership and external partners.
* Comfortable working with data, systems and technology.
* Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Curious and willing to learn, experiment and improve existing ways of working.
* Discreet and mature when handling confidential employee information.

**Experience \& Qualifications**
--------------------------------


* **3–6 years of relevant experience** in HR, L\&D, People Operations or a related area.
* A **Master's degree** in HR, Management, Psychology, Business Administration or a related field would be preferred.
* Experience in a non\-profit or mission\-driven organisation is an advantage, but not essential.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across teams and leadership.
* Ability to balance and reconcile diverse stakeholder needs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Compensation will be offered in line with industry standards, commensurate with experience and qualifications.


Eligible employees will receive PF benefits as per applicable organisational policy and statutory requirements.


Employees will be covered under the organisation's health insurance/medical benefits as per the applicable policy. Additional employee benefits will be provided in accordance with CCS policies.

title: Global Learning & Talent Development Specialist (m/f/d)
company: Hellmann Worldwide Logistics SE & Co. KG
description:
**About Us**
============


Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward\-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10\.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide.  

For the better. Together.

  


Are you ready to take the next step in your career? As a Global Talent and Organization Development Senior (m/f/d) at Hellmann Worldwide Logistics, you will play a key role in shaping our global HR landscape. This position offers a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting HR transformation journey—where you take ownership, drive innovation, and collaborate with a team of passionate professionals. **About the job**


Learning strategy and capability building

* Develop and deliver a global learning and capability\-building strategy aligned with business priorities and our people strategy.
* Run learning needs analyses and identify capability gaps across functions, regions and talent groups.
* Build capability frameworks and learning roadmaps that support organizational growth and transformation.
* Translate business requirements into practical, sustainable learning solutions.


Learning design and development

* Design, develop and continuously improve learning solutions for classroom, virtual, hybrid and self\-paced digital formats.
* Create facilitator guides, participant materials, toolkits, assessments, videos, e\-learning modules and blended programs.
* Apply modern instructional design methods and adult learning principles to keep learning engaging and effective.
* Keep content scalable, learner\-centered and globally relevant, while allowing for local adaptation.


Talent and leadership development

* Design and manage global talent and leadership development programs, including offers for emerging leaders, high potentials and critical talent groups.
* Build career development pathways and learning journeys that support career growth and internal mobility.
* Partner with stakeholders on succession\-related development and targeted capability building.
* Support onboarding, upskilling and reskilling as part of an integrated talent approach.


Organizational development

* Contribute to organizational development work such as capability modeling, role architecture and organizational effectiveness.
* Support the design of career frameworks and organizational capability assessments.
* Bring a learning lens to change and transformation initiatives.


Learning technology and measurement

* Work with our HRIS and technology teams to make the most of our learning management system and other learning technologies.
* Manage learning content deployment, learner experience, reporting and analytics.
* Measure learning effectiveness through data, feedback and business impact, and act on what you find.
* Track external trends and emerging technologies to keep our learning ecosystem current.

**About you**


Must\-have

* At least five years of experience in learning and development, talent development, instructional design or a related field.
* Experience designing and delivering global learning and talent programs in a multinational organization.
* A track record of building learning solutions across classroom, virtual, hybrid and digital channels.
* Experience designing leadership development or talent acceleration programs.
* Experience building learning journeys, development pathways or career frameworks.
* Experience working with a learning management system.
* Strong knowledge of instructional design methods, for example ADDIE, SAM, design thinking or learning experience design, and a solid grounding in adult learning theory.
* A degree in HR, organizational psychology, education, learning sciences, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Excellent communication and storytelling, strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, and a global, intercultural mindset.
* The ability to balance strategic work with hands\-on execution.


Nice\-to\-have

* Certification in instructional design, learning experience design, adult learning, facilitation, coaching or leadership development.
* Familiarity with learning analytics and evaluation frameworks such as Kirkpatrick.
* Experience with AI\-enabled learning solutions and adaptive learning platforms.
* Experience developing large\-scale global leadership academies or enterprise reskilling initiatives.
* Knowledge of organizational design, workforce planning or change management methodologies.
* Familiarity with skills\-based talent management and career architecture frameworks.
* Additional language skills beyond English.

**How you work**


We are looking for someone whose way of working reflects our values:

* Caring. You build trusted relationships, listen well and keep learners and colleagues at the center of what you design.
* Entrepreneurial. You take ownership, show initiative and stay focused on the impact your work has on the business.
* Forward\-Thinking. You bring curiosity and a digital mindset, and you keep improving how we learn and develop.
* Reliable. You deliver quality work on time, follow through on commitments and measure whether it worked.


Inclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you!


If you are excited by this fantastic opportunity and have what it takes, then click APPLY!

title: MIS Executive
description:
Advanced MIS Executive – NBFC / Fintech

We are looking for an experienced **Advanced MIS Executive** to manage business reporting, data analysis, and management dashboards across **disbursements, collections, and portfolio performance**.

The ideal candidate should be highly proficient in **Advanced Excel and SQL**, comfortable working with large datasets from multiple systems, and capable of automating recurring reports and dashboards. Candidates with experience in **NBFC, fintech, lending, financial services, or similar data\-driven environments** will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and manage **daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports**.
* Track and report **loan disbursements, collections, portfolio performance, and other business KPIs**.
* Extract, consolidate, clean, and validate data from multiple internal and external/vendor systems.
* Develop automated reports and dashboards to reduce manual reporting effort.
* Perform data analysis and identify trends, gaps, exceptions, and performance issues.
* Create management\-level dashboards and reports for business reviews.
* Ensure **accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery** of MIS to management and business partners.
* Work closely with operations, collections, finance, credit, and other teams for reporting requirements.
* Handle large datasets using **Advanced Excel and SQL**.
* Support ad\-hoc data analysis and reporting requirements from management.
* Improve existing MIS processes through automation and better data controls.

Required Skills

* Strong hands\-on knowledge of **Advanced Excel**, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX\-MATCH, advanced formulas, data validation, charts, and data analysis.
* Strong working knowledge of **SQL** for extracting and analyzing data.
* Good understanding of MIS reporting, data reconciliation, and dashboard preparation.
* Ability to work with large volumes of data with a high level of accuracy.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Knowledge of **Power BI or another BI/reporting tool** will be an advantage.

Experience

* **4–6 years** of relevant experience preferred.
* Experience in **NBFC, fintech, lending, banking, financial services, collections, or loan operations** will be preferred.
* Candidates with strong MIS and data analytics experience from other industries may also apply if they have excellent **Excel and SQL skills**.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is not limited to preparing routine Excel reports, but can **understand business data, automate reporting, build dashboards, identify insights, and independently manage the MIS function**.

* Logical decision\-making, effective listening, clarity of thought and utmost professionalism.

Basic/ Essential Qualifications:


* Bachelor’s degree


You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


This role will be based out of Gurgaon/ Pune.


The role holder will work in a UK shift of 12:30\-9:30 PM.


**Purpose of the role**


To support the business with the management of employee relations cases, in line with relevant policies, procedures and regulatory requirements. This includes providing professional advice, support and guidance to managers and employees on a range of topics (including Disciplinary, Capability, Grievance and Sickness), and investigating matters where required.


**Accountabilities**


* Provision of ER advice on a range of topics, including reviewing and drafting of documentation, advising on process as well as potential employment / legal risk. Supporting directly where required, often with senior complex, and regulatory matters.
* Investigations to resolve employee complaints, grievances, and disciplinary matters and guidance on the completion of these, supporting managers and employees as required.
* Employee relations policies and procedures development, implementation, and maintenance, aligning these to all applicable laws, regulations and the overall business strategy.
* Production and deployment of ER training in coordination with our control partners with a focus on prevention.
* Production and delivery of ER metrics, sharing insights with stakeholders on employee relations issues and trends.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**


* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: India Lead Specialist Human Resources - Staffing
description:

What You'll Bring
